name: Hanza AB (publ)
summary: Hanza AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, provides contract manufacturing solutions in Sweden, Finland, Estonia, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, rest of the European Union, Norway, rest of Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through Main Markets, Other Markets, and Business Development and Services segments.
